findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered without a React key in the filtered rule list
findings.body: When rendering rules of origin 'grafana', the previous code passed `key={key}` to GrafanaRuleLoader; the new GrafanaRuleListItem call omits the key entirely (the `datasource` and `default` branches still pass keys). In a list that grows via infinite scroll and re-renders, React cannot stably identify these items, which can cause incorrect DOM reuse/state reuse (e.g. open dropdowns or drawers attaching to the wrong rule) and wasted re-renders. The key should be restored.

findings.title: Delete (and Pause) menu actions never render in the alert list view
findings.body: In the new ruler-less list view, AlertRuleMenu is invoked with rulerRule undefined (GrafanaRuleListItem passes only promRule). The Delete item is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule` (line 165) and the Pause item on `canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123), so even though the new promRule-based abilities (`grafanaDeleteAbility`, `grafanaPauseAbility`) are computed and can be true, the menu items are never rendered. Users lose the ability to delete or pause Grafana-managed rules from the list view — a functional regression the new promRule ability code was meant to enable. Delete also needs a new identifier-based flow since handleDelete currently requires a RulerRuleDTO.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens when only promRule is provided
findings.body: In the list view path only `promRule` is passed (rule/rulerRule undefined). The 'Silence notifications' menu item does render because `canSilence` can now be satisfied via useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities, but the drawer is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`, and `rule` is undefined here. Clicking 'Silence notifications' sets state that has no effect — the silence drawer silently never appears. The condition needs to also handle the GrafanaPromRuleDTO case (and SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer needs a prom-rule-based invocation).

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable in useAllRulerRuleAbilities
findings.body: The refactored useAllRulerRuleAbilities hardcodes `const isFederated = false` with a TODO. The previous useAllAlertRuleAbilities computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` and used it to mark federated rules as immutable (no edit/delete/pause/duplicate). Since useAllAlertRuleAbilities now delegates to this hook and no longer receives the rule group, federated Mimir rule groups will incorrectly be reported as editable/deletable, allowing users to attempt unsupported mutations on federated rules.

findings.title: Rule view link lost the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The deleted GrafanaRuleLoader built the list-item href with `createRelativeUrl('/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view', { returnTo })` so navigating to a rule from the list and back preserved the list context. The new GrafanaRuleListItem creates the URL without returnTo, so users clicking a rule from the filtered list lose their filter/list context when returning. Confirm this drop is intentional; if not, restore the returnTo parameter.

findings.title: showDivider expression wraps single values in arrays and is misleading
findings.body: `[canPause, canSilence, shouldShowDeclareIncidentButton, canDuplicate].some(Boolean) && [canExport].some(Boolean)` — the second clause is equivalent to plain `canExport`. Beyond style, this makes the divider logic hard to verify and suggests an intended condition that was never written (e.g. shareUrl should probably also gate the divider, otherwise 'Copy link' can appear directly above/below a divider inconsistently when canExport is false). Simplify to an explicit expression.

findings.title: getGrafanaRuleKey emits a stray '}' in the generated key
findings.body: The template literal ends with `${rule.uid}}`, adding a literal closing brace to every grafana rule key. Harmless for uniqueness today but it is a typo that will confuse anyone extending the key format, and since this key mechanism was just re-wired (and is the key that should be passed to GrafanaRuleListItem per the missing-key finding), fix the stray character.
